proof:
Source: the parent proof's steps 2a–2f, i.e. Simon Ch. 3, printed proof of Lemma 1.2 ('only if'), with details filled in.

Notation. ℝⁿ = Rn n with Lⁿ = volume; ℝ^{n+ℓ} = Amb n ℓ; Hⁿ = μHE[n]; on ℝⁿ itself Hⁿ = Lⁿ (InnerProductSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume, finrank ℝⁿ = n). B_r(b) is the closed ball, B°_r(b) the open ball. The sibling c1_approximation states: for n ≥ 1, every Lipschitz h : ℝⁿ → ℝ and every ε > 0 there is a C¹ function g : ℝⁿ → ℝ with Lⁿ({h ≠ g}) < ε.

Proof.
1. Rectifiability data. By the definition of Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable there are M₀ with Hⁿ(M₀) = 0 and maps F_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} (j ∈ ℕ), F_j being K_j-Lipschitz, with M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝⁿ). Put N' := n + ℓ ≥ 1 and F_j^q(z) := F_j(z)_q, the q-th coordinate (q = 1, …, N'); each F_j^q is K_j-Lipschitz.
2. C¹ approximation (parent 2b). For i ≥ 1 and each q, the sibling c1_approximation gives a C¹ function g_{ij}^q : ℝⁿ → ℝ with Lⁿ({F_j^q ≠ g_{ij}^q}) < 1/(iN'). Let G_{ij}(z) be the point of ℝ^{n+ℓ} with coordinates (g_{ij}^1(z), …, g_{ij}^{N'}(z)). G_{ij} is C¹, since its coordinates are C¹ and the coordinate identification ℝ^{n+ℓ} ≅ ℝ^{N'} is a continuous linear equivalence. Since {F_j ≠ G_{ij}} ⊆ ⋃_q {F_j^q ≠ g_{ij}^q}, we get Lⁿ({F_j ≠ G_{ij}}) < 1/i.
3. The sets Z_j. Z_j := ⋂_{i≥1} {F_j ≠ G_{ij}} satisfies Lⁿ(Z_j) ≤ 1/i for all i, so Lⁿ(Z_j) = 0. By the Lipschitz image bound (SimonGMT Chapter02.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image_le_of_lipschitzOn) and Hⁿ = Lⁿ on ℝⁿ, Hⁿ(F_j(Z_j)) ≤ K_jⁿ·Lⁿ(Z_j) = 0. If z ∉ Z_j then F_j(z) = G_{ij}(z) for some i; hence F_j(ℝⁿ) ⊆ F_j(Z_j) ∪ ⋃_i G_{ij}(ℝⁿ).
4. Critical sets (parent 2c). Let C_{ij} := {b : DG_{ij}(b) is not injective} and O_{ij} := ℝⁿ ∖ C_{ij}. O_{ij} is open: it is the preimage of the open set of injective linear maps (ContinuousLinearMap.isOpen_injective) under the continuous map b ↦ DG_{ij}(b) (ContDiff.continuous_fderiv). Since G_{ij} is differentiable everywhere, C_{ij} = {b : G_{ij} is differentiable at b and DG_{ij}(b) is not injective}, so SimonGMT Chapter02.area_image_criticalSet_eq_zero gives Hⁿ(G_{ij}(C_{ij})) = 0.
5. Local lower Lipschitz bound (parent 2d). Fix b ∈ O_{ij} and put L := DG_{ij}(b). L is an injective linear map on the finite-dimensional space ℝⁿ, hence antilipschitz (LinearMap.injective_iff_antilipschitz): there is s_b > 0 with |Lv| ≥ s_b|v| for all v ∈ ℝⁿ. By continuity of DG_{ij} and openness of O_{ij} choose ρ_b > 0 with B_{ρ_b}(b) ⊆ O_{ij} and ‖DG_{ij}(b') − L‖ ≤ s_b/2 for all b' ∈ B_{ρ_b}(b). The C¹ map φ := G_{ij} − L has Dφ = DG_{ij} − L, so the mean value inequality on the convex ball (Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le) gives |φ(b') − φ(b'')| ≤ (s_b/2)|b' − b''| for b', b'' ∈ B_{ρ_b}(b). Consequently |G_{ij}(b') − G_{ij}(b'')| ≥ |L(b' − b'')| − |φ(b') − φ(b'')| ≥ (s_b/2)|b' − b''| for all b', b'' ∈ B_{ρ_b}(b), in particular on the open ball B°_{ρ_b}(b). Moreover DG_{ij}(b') is injective for every b' ∈ B°_{ρ_b}(b) ⊆ O_{ij}. (The parent reaches the same bound after composing with a coordinate projection z for which z∘L is invertible; s_b plays the role of ‖(D(z∘G_{ij})(b))^(−1)‖^(−1).)
6. Lindelöf (parent 2f). The open balls B°_{ρ_b}(b), b ∈ O_{ij}, cover O_{ij}. ℝⁿ is second countable, so there is a countable T_{ij} ⊆ O_{ij} with O_{ij} = ⋃_{b ∈ T_{ij}} B°_{ρ_b}(b) (TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable).
7. Enumeration. The set of triples (i, j, b) with i ≥ 1, j ∈ ℕ and b ∈ T_{ij} is countable. Enumerate it as k ↦ (i_k, j_k, b_k) and put G_k := G_{i_k j_k}, c_k := b_k, r_k := ρ_{b_k} > 0 and σ_k := s_{b_k}/2 > 0. If there are only finitely many triples (or none), fill the remaining indices with the dummy piece G(z) := (z, 0) ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} (first n coordinates z, last ℓ coordinates 0): it is a linear isometric embedding, hence C¹ with injective derivative equal to itself, and c := 0, r := 1, σ := 1 work for it. By step 5 every piece satisfies: DG_k(b) is injective for b ∈ B°_{r_k}(c_k), and σ_k|b₁ − b₂| ≤ |G_k(b₁) − G_k(b₂)| for b₁, b₂ ∈ B°_{r_k}(c_k).
8. The null set. Let Z₀ := toMeasurable Hⁿ (M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(Z_j) ∪ ⋃_{i,j} G_{ij}(C_{ij})). It is Borel, and as a measurable hull of a countable union of Hⁿ-null sets (steps 1, 3, 4) it satisfies Hⁿ(Z₀) = 0.
9. Covering. Let x ∈ M. If x ∈ M₀ then x ∈ Z₀. Otherwise x = F_j(z) for some j and z. If z ∈ Z_j then x ∈ F_j(Z_j) ⊆ Z₀. Otherwise F_j(z) = G_{ij}(z) for some i. If z ∈ C_{ij} then x ∈ G_{ij}(C_{ij}) ⊆ Z₀. Otherwise z ∈ O_{ij}, so z ∈ B°_{ρ_b}(b) for some b ∈ T_{ij}, and x = G_k(z) ∈ G_k(B°_{r_k}(c_k)) for the index k of the triple (i, j, b). Hence M ⊆ Z₀ ∪ ⋃_k G_k(B°_{r_k}(c_k)). ∎
